metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 higher over Wuhan, China in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about PM2.5 levels over Wuhan, China comparing February 2020 vs February 2019. 1. **Data Strategy**: I need PM2.5 data. Google Earth Engine has several air quality datasets: - MODIS MAIAC AOD (can be converted to PM2.5) - MERRA-2 (has PM2.5) - Sentinel-5P (has AOD which can be related to PM2.5) I'll use MERRA-2 since it directly provides PM2.5 data. 2. **Location**: Wuhan, China. I'll create a point geometry around Wuhan coordinates (approx 30.6°N, 114.3°E). 3. **Time Period**: February 2019 vs February 2020. 4. **Processing**: - Get monthly mean PM2.5 for each February - Compare the values - Check for valid data 5. **Validation**: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist - Validate the PM2.5 values are reasonable (not NaN, within typical range) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]); // February 2019 and February 2020 const feb2019_start = '2019-02-01'; const feb2019_end = '2019-02-28'; const feb2020_start = '2020-02-01'; const feb2020_end = '2020-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using MERRA-2 for PM2.5 const getPM25Collection = function(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('PM25'); // PM2.5 dust column mass density (kg/m²) }; const pm25_2019 = getPM25Collection(feb2019_start, feb2019_end); const pm25_2020 = getPM25Collection(feb2020_start, feb2020_end); // Check collection sizes const size2019 = pm25_2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = pm25_2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate monthly mean PM2.5 const mean2019 = pm25_2019.mean(); const mean2020 = pm25_2020.mean(); // Get pixel counts and values const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pm25_2019_val = stats2019.PM25_mean; const pm25_2020_val = stats2020.PM25_mean; const count2019 = stats2019.PM25_count; const count2020 = stats2020.PM25_count; console.log(`2019 PM2.5: ${pm25_2019_val?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 PM2.5: ${pm25_2020_val?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (pm25_2019_val === null || pm25_2020_val === null || isNaN(pm25_2019_val) || isNaN(pm25_2020_val)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if values are reasonable (PM2.5 should be positive and typically < 1e-5 kg/m²) if (pm25_2019_val < 0 || pm25_2020_val < 0 || pm25_2019_val > 1e-4 || pm25_2020_val > 1e-4) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare PM2.5 values if (pm25_2020_val > pm25_2019_val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
